title: Third-mechanism and shared-endpoint support audit for The Intervention Knowledge Bottleneck
required_unit: A third independent self-evolution mechanism with first-party, source-native units that directly measure the same entity-level modification/intervention-knowledge endpoint as the frozen candidate, with at least 8 aligned units across at least 3 mutation/operation types, plus a source-native comparison showing that the failure persists under more single-turn or non-entity-grounded data and changes under targeted entity-grounded or multi-turn intervention evidence.

canonical_source_pair.title: SkillForge: Self-Distilling Agents for Project-Specific Issue Resolution
canonical_source_pair.entity_level_bridge: The same ablation section separately states that repository-level diagnostic knowledge and entity-level intervention knowledge are complementary.

canonical_source_pair.title: SkillEvo: Self-Renewing Evolution Gradients from Multi-Turn Interaction Feedback
canonical_source_pair.direct_endpoint: single-turn feedback gradient saturation versus multi-turn feedback
canonical_source_pair.entity_level_bridge: No canonical Primary fact directly labels the measured SkillEvo failure as entity-level modification/intervention knowledge.

shared_endpoint_audit.reason: The frozen CONVERGENT_FAILURE candidate relies on a generator-authored bridge from SkillEvo's single-turn plateau to entity-level intervention defects. SkillForge directly measures intervention-knowledge ablation, while SkillEvo directly measures feedback-source/multi-turn saturation. Those are not yet the same source-defined endpoint.

third_mechanism_shortlist.title: MindMemOS: A Portable and Self-Evolving Memory Operating Layer for AI Agents
third_mechanism_shortlist.reason: The released mechanism evolves memory schemas/entities/properties; it does not expose the candidate's source-defined entity-level code-modification/intervention-knowledge failure or the matched targeted-entity versus generic/more-data contrast.

third_mechanism_shortlist.title: EvoGraph-R1: Self-Evolving Multimodal Knowledge Hypergraphs for Agentic Retrieval
third_mechanism_shortlist.reason: Graph-edit units modify retrieval knowledge structures rather than measuring acquisition of code-entity intervention knowledge; no source-native aligned unit table for the frozen endpoint was identified.

third_mechanism_shortlist.title: SciToolAgent-Evo: An Ontology-Aware Self-Evolving Agent for Open-World Scientific Tool Acquisition
third_mechanism_shortlist.unit_scale_observed: OpenSciToolBench reports 900 tasks and atomic computational primitives.
third_mechanism_shortlist.reason: The source measures open-world tool capability acquisition and ontology completion, not the frozen entity-level modification/intervention-knowledge endpoint or its matched data-structure contrast.

third_mechanism_shortlist.title: From Atomic Actions to Standard Operating Procedures: Iterative Tool Optimization for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
third_mechanism_shortlist.reason: EvoSOP evolves higher-order tools from atomic actions; the released evaluation is not a same entity-level intervention-knowledge measurement.

third_mechanism_shortlist.title: DeepSearch-World: Self-Distillation for Deep Search Agents in a Verifiable Environment
third_mechanism_shortlist.reason: Its entity-level random walks construct QA tasks; they do not constitute entity-level modification/intervention units for the self-evolution mechanism.

third_mechanism_shortlist.title: Agentic ESOpt: Fine-Tuning Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Minimal GPU Requirements
third_mechanism_shortlist.reason: The source exposes only two named mutation operators in the relevant integration, below the frozen >=3 operation-type headroom, and evaluates heuristic/parameter evolution rather than entity-level modification knowledge.

third_mechanism_shortlist.title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement
third_mechanism_shortlist.reason: It supplies multiple frozen algorithm-design tasks but is an evaluation substrate, not an independent self-evolution acquisition mechanism exhibiting the frozen failure endpoint.

reopen_only_if: Reopen only after primary or author-released first-party evidence closes both missing conditions: (1) SkillEvo or a reformulated independent source directly exposes a source-defined entity-level modification/intervention-knowledge endpoint comparable to SkillForge, rather than a generator-authored bridge from generic multi-turn gain; and (2) a third independent self-evolution mechanism supplies at least 8 source-native aligned units across at least 3 mutation/operation types plus a matched structural test separating targeted entity-grounded or multi-turn intervention evidence from merely more single-turn/non-entity-grounded data. Synthetic proxies, relabeling unrelated entity/schema/tool units, or candidate-mechanism injection do not reopen this HOLD.
